message.content:
Here are some of the most prominent airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic, connectivity, and overall importance:

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| **Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL)** | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest passenger airport in the world; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| **Los Angeles International Airport (LAX)** | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Key gateway to Asia, Oceania, and Latin America; major hub for American Airlines and Delta. |
| **Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD)** | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; hub for United and American. |
| **Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW)** | Dallas/Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the largest single-runway airports. |
| **Denver International Airport (DEN)** | Denver, CO | DEN | Largest airport by land area in the U.S.; hub for United and Southwest. |
| **John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK)** | New York, NY | JFK | Primary gateway to Europe and the Caribbean; hub for many international carriers. |
| **San Francisco International Airport (SFO)** | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Major hub for United and a key gateway to Asia. |
| **Seattle‑Tacoma International Airport (SEA)** | Seattle, WA | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for Delta. |
| **Orlando International Airport (MCO)** | Orlando, FL | MCO | Major leisure hub; serves numerous charter and low‑cost carriers. |
| **Miami International Airport (MIA)** | Miami, FL | MIA | Key hub for Latin American traffic; major hub for American Airlines. |
| **Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX)** | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Hub for American Airlines; high volume of domestic flights. |
| **George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH)** | Houston, TX | IAH | Major hub for United Airlines; significant cargo operations. |
| **Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT)** | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest‑growing airports. |
| **McCarran International Airport (LAS)** | Las Vegas, NV | LAS | Major leisure hub; serves many low‑cost carriers. |
| **Boston Logan International Airport (BOS)** | Boston, MA | BOS | Major hub for Northeast traffic; key for airlines like JetBlue and Delta. |

These airports are critical nodes in the U.S. aviation network, handling millions of passengers annually and connecting to destinations worldwide.
